# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** In her twenties by Volume 5  <sub>[v1 c25 P48](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0048), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive; Married  <sub>[v1 c33 P24](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0024), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher (formerly)  <sub>[v1 c26 P24](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette has a rounded, plump figure. On her wedding day, she wore an opulent trousseau that included a gown of white satin, tulle, lace, and orange blossoms, along with a prominent cluster diamond engagement ring.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Odette has a practical, sensible, and matter-of-fact nature. She is friendly, cheerful, and unpretentious, lacking any inclination toward vanity, envy, or malice. Though not given to great imagination, she is a diligent, hardworking student and a reliable, capable person who is well-liked by her peers.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c34 P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)_

- Practical and pragmatic  <sub>[v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019)</sub>
- Unpretentious and friendly  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c34 P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)</sub>

## Abilities

- Domestic science and cooking  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)</sub>
- Academic diligence and teaching  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- To qualify as a teacher and earn an income  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
- To live a comfortable, happy life with her husband  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c34 P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)</sub>

## History

Odette grew up in Brierley as the daughter of Gorham Pullen and attended the local school alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke. As a student, she participated in school events, including the Sunday-school picnic and the Christmas concert. After finishing her studies under Miss Thorne, she joined the Regent's class to prepare for the entrance examination. She successfully passed the Entrance exams and attended Regent's Academy in Port Marlow to earn her First Class teaching license. Upon graduating, she secured a teaching position at the Stonebridge school. She later accepted a teaching job on the Western Canadian prairies, where she met Mr. Inglis, a wealthy English mining investor from Winnipeg. They were married in a lavish ceremony in Brierley before relocating to Winnipeg.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P24](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0024), [v1 c33 P24](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0024), [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c34 P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)_
